name: Marilee Langner Sturgis

summary.text: Marilee Langner Sturgis is the Approval Voting Party nominee for Colorado state treasurer on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

finance.note: No campaign committee is registered with the Colorado Secretary of State as of October 16, 2026, so there are no totals to report.

research_notes: No sourceable biography or positions found anywhere searched. She has not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey (page has no biography fields filled in). iVoterGuide's profile shows 'Candidate did not provide' for education, work/military history, affiliations and offices held, and has no questionnaire answers on file. The Oct. 2, 2026 Colorado Politics joint candidate questionnaire for this race states plainly: 'Marilee Langner Sturgis of the Approval Voting Party did not respond.' No campaign website could be found. This profile is essentially limited to confirming her name, party and candidacy; a reviewer should not expect more without a direct interview or late-arriving questionnaire response. Second pass 2026-10-14: the Denver Post's Oct. 3, 2026 treasurer candidate Q&A confirms 'Marilee Langner Sturgis and Jodie Barr did not return the questionnaire.' Re-checked her Ballot Brief and iVoterGuide profiles and the Colorado Sun's Amendment 87/Proposition 136 explainers; none add any biography or position content. No new positions were added.
